scripts.setup: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.lock && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm run build:backend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm run build:backend && ctest --test-dir backend/build/native --output-on-failure && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pytest backend/tests/native -q
